notes: New in 2.3.2: Test now checks what each AI model can do. Open Settings → Brain (AI keys), tap a key, tap Test. It sends the model a tiny photo, a half-second sound, a one-word PDF and a tiny tool call, then shows "This model can:" with ✓ or ✗ for Chat, Photos, Voice, PDF, Pictures and Tools. It ticks every "Use for" job the model can do and greys out the ones it can't, with the reason (for example "This model can't see photos, hear voice notes or read PDFs"). If a model can see photos but can't hear, the Voice, photos & files box stays on and says "photos ✓ voice ✗". After that, voice notes only go to keys that can hear and photos only to keys that can see. If a free limit is hit during Test, it says "couldn't check" instead of ✗ and leaves that tick alone; tap Test again later. Keys you have not tested yet keep their ticks and work like before. The Activity log shows each Test, e.g. "Tested 'Groq': chat ✓ tools ✓ photos ✗ voice ✗".
